text: International Holding Company (IHC) is ultimately controlled by the Royal Group, a conglomerate whose president is Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan (International Investor, April 2021).
short: IHC is controlled by Sheikh Tahnoon's Royal Group

source.name: International Investor: Abu Dhabi IHC adds stake in the main constructor in the United Arab Emirates with the latest agreement
source.quote: Ultimately, IHC is controlled by the Royal Group, a conglomerate that includes Sheikh Tahnoon Bin Zayed Al Nahyan as president
